name: Cash Deposit Or Withdrawal Cancellation Request V 01
definition: The CashDepositOrWithdrawalCancellationRequest message requests the cancellation of a cash deposit request or cash withdrawal request.|Where requesting cancellation of a cash deposit request, it is sent by a cash receiver to a cash sender.|Where requesting cancellation of a cash withdrawal request, it is sent by a cash sender to a cash receiver.

GroupHeader.name: Group Header
GroupHeader.definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual notifications included in the message.

UnderlyingTransaction.name: Underlying Transaction
UnderlyingTransaction.definition: Identifies the request to be cancelled.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information incorporated as an extension to the message.
